title: A bulk change that fails with a server error shows Failed to update part status and fades after 7 seconds
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. (Admin has Part Library & Inventory > Delete.) QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T2 are active. Chrome DevTools > Network request blocking: add the pattern "inventory/parts/status" (the blocked call fails like a server error). A stopwatch.
custom_steps:
1. Enable the request-blocking pattern.
  2. Parts > Inventory, Active tab > the actions menu (button_inventory_actions) > Deactivate parts; tick QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T2 and click Deactivate on the bulk bar.
  3. Click Deactivate (red) in the confirmation; start the stopwatch when the toast appears.
  4. Do not touch the toast; watch it.
  5. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
  6. Disable request blocking; open the Inactive tab, then QAPL-T1's Part History.
custom_expected:
1. Blocking is on for inventory/parts/status.
  2. "Deactivate parts?" opens with "2 parts selected."
  3. The status call fails; a red error toast (toast_bulk_status_error) reads "Failed to update part status" with "Please try again or contact support for help"; the confirmation stays open.
  4. The toast fades on its own after about 7 seconds.
  5. The confirmation closes; bulk mode stays on with both parts still ticked ("2 selected") on the Active tab.
  6. Neither part is on the Inactive tab; QAPL-T1 has no new "Deactivated" entry.
